inputs.original_text: Earlier this month, an Indiana judge blocked a prolife law, arguing that limiting abortion violates freedom of religion. The American Civil Liberties Union and Hoosier Jews for Choice brought the claim, arguing the Indiana law “violates religious freedoms by burdening the ability to obtain an abortion in accordance with their sincerely held beliefs.” The message names Judge Christina R. [...] and says the post was titled “This Judge Thinks Killing Babies in Abortions is a Religious Right.”
